```{r setup}
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)
library(tidyr)

if (file.exists("../.env")) readRenviron("../.env")
source("../R/supabase.R")
source("../R/rink_plot.R")
source("../R/analytics.R")
```

```{r load-data}
#| include: false

players  <- sb_select("players",  filters = c("active" = "eq.true"),
                      order = "jersey_num.asc")
games    <- sb_select("games",    order = "game_date.asc")
faceoffs <- sb_select("faceoffs")
hits     <- sb_select("hits")
shots    <- sb_select("shots")
goals    <- sb_select("goals")
on_ice   <- sb_select("on_ice")

# ── Filter to selected game if a game_id param was passed ──────────────────
filter_by_game <- function(df) {
  gid <- params$game_id
  if (is.null(gid) || is.na(gid) || nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  df[df$game_id == as.integer(gid), ]
}

faceoffs <- filter_by_game(faceoffs)
hits      <- filter_by_game(hits)
shots     <- filter_by_game(shots)
goals     <- filter_by_game(goals)
on_ice    <- filter_by_game(on_ice)

# ── Add xG to shots ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
shots <- add_xg(shots)

# ── Helper: join player name ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
add_player_name <- function(df, id_col = "player_id") {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  df |> left_join(players |> select(id, jersey_num, full_name, position),
                  by = setNames("id", id_col))
}

add_game_label <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  df |>
    left_join(games |> select(id, game_date, opponent),
              by = c("game_id" = "id")) |>
    mutate(game_label = paste0(game_date, " vs ", opponent))
}

faceoffs <- faceoffs |> add_player_name() |> add_game_label()
hits      <- hits     |> add_player_name() |> add_game_label()
shots     <- shots    |> add_player_name() |> add_game_label()
goals     <- goals    |>
  left_join(players |> select(id, scorer_name = full_name,
                              scorer_num = jersey_num),
            by = c("scorer_id" = "id")) |>
  add_game_label()
on_ice <- on_ice |> add_player_name() |> add_game_label()

# ── Compute full player stats table ─────────────────────────────────────────
n_games_covered <- if (is.null(params$game_id)) nrow(games) else 1L
player_stats <- compute_player_stats(
  players  = players,
  shots    = shots,
  goals    = goals,
  faceoffs = faceoffs,
  hits     = hits,
  n_games  = n_games_covered
)

vt_goals  <- sum(goals$team == "VT",       na.rm = TRUE)
opp_goals <- sum(goals$team == "opponent", na.rm = TRUE)
vt_shots  <- shots[!is.na(shots$team) & shots$team == "VT", ]
```

---

# `r params$game_label`

::: {.callout-note}
`r if (is.null(params$game_id)) "Season aggregate — all games." else paste0("Single game report: ", params$game_label)`
Data pulled live from Supabase at render time.
:::

```{r overview}
#| echo: false
fo_wins  <- sum(faceoffs$result == "win",  na.rm = TRUE)
fo_total <- nrow(faceoffs)
cat(sprintf(
  "Games covered : %d\nScore         : VT %d — Opp %d\nShots         : %d\nFaceoffs      : %d W / %d (%.1f%%)\nTotal Hits    : %d\nTeam xG       : %.2f\n",
  n_games_covered, vt_goals, opp_goals,
  nrow(vt_shots), fo_wins, fo_total,
  ifelse(fo_total > 0, fo_wins / fo_total * 100, 0),
  nrow(hits),
  sum(vt_shots$xg, na.rm = TRUE)
))
```

---

# Team Summary

## Scoring & Shot Quality

```{r team-scoring}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(vt_shots) == 0) {
  cat("No shot data recorded yet.")
} else {
  vt_shots |>
    summarise(
      `Shots`          = n(),
      `On Goal`        = sum(result %in% c("goal","save"), na.rm = TRUE),
      `Goals`          = sum(result == "goal", na.rm = TRUE),
      `Shooting %`     = paste0(round(mean(result == "goal", na.rm=TRUE)*100,1),"%"),
      `Total xG`       = round(sum(xg, na.rm=TRUE), 2),
      `Avg xG/Shot`    = round(mean(xg, na.rm=TRUE), 3),
      `Goals − xG`     = round(sum(result == "goal", na.rm=TRUE) -
                                sum(xg, na.rm=TRUE), 2)
    ) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "VT Team Shooting") |>
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
              locations = cells_column_labels())
}
```

## Shot Results Breakdown

```{r shot-results}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(vt_shots) == 0) {
  cat("No shot data.")
} else {
  vt_shots |>
    count(result, name = "Count") |>
    mutate(
      result = case_match(result,
        "goal"    ~ "Goal",
        "save"    ~ "On Goal (Save)",
        "missed"  ~ "Missed Net",
        "blocked" ~ "Blocked",
        .default  = result),
      `%` = paste0(round(Count/sum(Count)*100, 1), "%")
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(Count)) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "Shot Attempt Breakdown") |>
    cols_label(result = "Result")
}
```

## Shot Danger Zones

```{r danger-zones}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(vt_shots) == 0 || sum(!is.na(vt_shots$x_coord)) == 0) {
  cat("No shot location data yet.")
} else {
  vt_shots |>
    filter(!is.na(x_coord)) |>
    mutate(zone = classify_danger(x_coord, y_coord)) |>
    group_by(zone) |>
    summarise(
      Shots  = n(),
      Goals  = sum(result == "goal", na.rm = TRUE),
      xG     = round(sum(xg, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      `Shot%`= paste0(round(Goals/Shots*100, 1), "%"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(match(zone, c("High Danger","Medium Danger","Low Danger"))) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "Shots by Danger Zone",
               subtitle = "High Danger = within 25 ft, angle ≤ 45°") |>
    data_color(columns = xG,
               palette = c("#f4cccc","#861F41"))
}
```

## Faceoffs

```{r faceoffs-team}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(faceoffs) == 0) {
  cat("No faceoff data.")
} else {
  faceoffs |>
    group_by(zone) |>
    summarise(Total = n(), Wins = sum(result=="win", na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") |>
    mutate(`Win %` = paste0(round(Wins/Total*100,1),"%"),
           zone = stringr::str_to_title(zone)) |>
    arrange(desc(Total)) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "Faceoffs by Zone")
}
```

# Player Summaries

## Skater Stats

```{r skater-table}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(player_stats) == 0) {
  cat("No player data recorded yet.")
} else {
  player_stats |>
    select(
      `#`          = jersey_num,
      Player       = full_name,
      Pos          = position,
      G            = goals,
      A1           = a1,
      A2           = a2,
      PTS          = points,
      S            = shots,
      `S%`         = shoot_pct,
      `xG`         = xg_total,
      `G−xG`       = g_minus_xg,
      `xG/S`       = xg_per_shot,
      `HD%`        = hd_pct,
      Hits         = hits,
      `FO%`        = fo_pct
    ) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "VT Skater Stats") |>
    tab_spanner("Scoring",     c(G, A1, A2, PTS)) |>
    tab_spanner("Shooting",    c(S, `S%`, xG, `G−xG`, `xG/S`, `HD%`)) |>
    tab_spanner("Physical",    c(Hits)) |>
    tab_spanner("Faceoffs",    c(`FO%`)) |>
    fmt_number(columns = c(xG, `G−xG`, `xG/S`), decimals = 2) |>
    fmt_missing(columns = everything(), missing_text = "—") |>
    data_color(
      columns = `G−xG`,
      palette = c("#d62020","#ffffff","#1655a2"),
      domain  = c(-2, 2)
    ) |>
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
              locations = cells_column_labels()) |>
    cols_align(align = "center",
               columns = c(G, A1, A2, PTS, S, `S%`, xG, `G−xG`,
                           `xG/S`, `HD%`, Hits, `FO%`))
}
```

**Column key:** G = Goals, A1/A2 = Primary/Secondary Assists, S% = Shooting %, xG = Expected Goals, G−xG = Goals above expected (positive = outperforming), xG/S = Shot quality, HD% = High danger shot %, FO% = Faceoff win %

## Faceoff Leaderboard

```{r fo-leaders}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(faceoffs) == 0) {
  cat("No faceoff data.")
} else {
  faceoffs |>
    group_by(full_name, jersey_num) |>
    summarise(Total = n(), Wins = sum(result=="win", na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") |>

    tab_header(title = "Faceoff Leaders", subtitle = "(min. 3 taken)") |>
    data_color(columns = `Win %`, palette = c("#f4cccc","#d4edda"))
}
```

# Shot Maps

## All VT Shots

```{r shot-map-all}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 5
loc_shots <- vt_shots[!is.na(vt_shots$x_coord), ]
if (nrow(loc_shots) == 0) cat("No shot location data yet.") else draw_rink(loc_shots)
```

## High Danger Zone Shots

```{r shot-map-hd}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 5
if (nrow(loc_shots) > 0) {
  hd <- loc_shots |>
    mutate(zone = classify_danger(x_coord, y_coord)) |>
    filter(zone == "High Danger")
  if (nrow(hd) > 0) draw_rink(hd) else cat("No high-danger shots recorded.")
}
```

## Shots by Period

```{r shot-map-period}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 5
if (nrow(loc_shots) > 0) {
  for (per in unique(loc_shots$period)) {
    sub <- loc_shots[loc_shots$period == per, ]
    lbl <- switch(per, "1"="1st Period","2"="2nd Period","3"="3rd Period",
                  "OT"="Overtime", per)
    p <- draw_rink(sub) +
      labs(title = lbl) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size=14, face="bold", color="#861F41"))
    print(p)
  }
}
```

# Advanced Analytics

## xG Distribution by Player

```{r xg-by-player}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 5
if (nrow(player_stats) == 0 || sum(player_stats$xg_total) == 0) {
  cat("No xG data yet.")
} else {
  player_stats |>
    filter(shots > 0) |>
    mutate(label = paste0("#", jersey_num, "\n", gsub(" .*","", full_name))) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(label, xg_total))) +
    geom_col(aes(y = xg_total), fill = "#861F41", alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_col(aes(y = goals),    fill = "#E5751F", alpha = 0.9,
             width = 0.4) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "xG vs Actual Goals by Player",
         subtitle = "Maroon bars = xG total  |  Orange bars = actual goals",
         x = NULL, y = "Value") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}
```

## Goals Above Expected

```{r g-minus-xg}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 4
if (nrow(player_stats) == 0 || sum(player_stats$shots) == 0) {
  cat("No data yet.")
} else {
  player_stats |>
    filter(shots > 0) |>
    mutate(
      label = paste0("#", jersey_num, " ", full_name),
      color = ifelse(g_minus_xg >= 0, "#1655a2", "#d62020")
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(label, g_minus_xg), y = g_minus_xg, fill = color)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Goals Above Expected (G − xG)",
         subtitle = "Blue = outperforming expectation  |  Red = underperforming",
         x = NULL, y = "G − xG") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
}
```

## Shot Quality vs Volume

```{r quality-vs-volume}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 5
if (nrow(player_stats) == 0 || sum(player_stats$shots) == 0) {
  cat("No data yet.")
} else {
  player_stats |>
    filter(shots >= 2) |>
    mutate(label = paste0("#", jersey_num, " ", gsub(" .*","", full_name))) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = shots_per_game, y = xg_per_shot, size = xg_total,
               color = g_minus_xg, label = label)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(size = 3, color = "black", vjust = -1, check_overlap = TRUE) +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "#d62020", mid = "#f5a623", high = "#1655a2",
                          midpoint = 0, name = "G−xG") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "xG Total", range = c(3, 10)) +
    labs(title  = "Shot Quality vs Shot Volume",
         subtitle = "Size = total xG  |  Colour = goals above/below expected",
         x = "Shots per Game",
         y = "Avg xG per Shot (Shot Quality)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
}
```

# Game-by-Game

```{r game-by-game}
#| echo: false
if (nrow(games) == 0) {
  cat("No games yet.")
} else {
  all_shots   <- sb_select("shots")
  all_goals   <- sb_select("goals")
  all_fo      <- sb_select("faceoffs")
  all_hits    <- sb_select("hits")

  if (nrow(all_shots) > 0) all_shots <- add_xg(all_shots)

  games |>
    left_join(all_goals |> filter(team=="VT") |> count(game_id, name="GF"),
              by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_goals |> filter(team=="opponent") |> count(game_id, name="GA"),
              by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_shots |> filter(!is.na(team) & team=="VT") |>
                count(game_id, name="Shots"), by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_shots |> filter(!is.na(team) & team=="VT") |>
                group_by(game_id) |>
                summarise(xGF = round(sum(xg, na.rm=TRUE),2), .groups="drop"),
              by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_fo |> filter(result=="win") |>
                count(game_id, name="FO_W"), by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_fo |> count(game_id, name="FO_T"), by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    left_join(all_hits |> filter(hit_type=="delivered") |>
                count(game_id, name="Hits"), by = c("id"="game_id")) |>
    mutate(across(c(GF,GA,Shots,FO_W,FO_T,Hits), ~replace_na(.x, 0L)),
           xGF    = replace_na(xGF, 0),
           `FO%`  = paste0(round(FO_W/pmax(FO_T,1)*100,0),"%"),
           Result = case_when(GF>GA~"W", GF<GA~"L", TRUE~"T")) |>
    arrange(game_date) |>
    select(Date=game_date, Opponent=opponent, Location=location,
           Result, GF, GA, Shots, xGF, `FO%`, Hits) |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "Game-by-Game Results") |>
    fmt_number(columns = xGF, decimals = 2) |>
    tab_style(style = cell_fill(color="#d4edda"), locations=cells_body(rows=Result=="W")) |>
    tab_style(style = cell_fill(color="#f4cccc"), locations=cells_body(rows=Result=="L")) |>
    cols_align(align="center", columns=c(Result,GF,GA,Shots,xGF,`FO%`,Hits))
}
```

---

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## xG Model Notes
Expected Goals (xG) are estimated using a logistic regression model trained on
shot location and type. Inputs: distance from net, horizontal angle, shot type.
Coefficients are calibrated so the average shot produces ~9–10% xG, consistent
with NHL-wide shooting percentages. This is a simplified model — production NHL
models also incorporate pre-shot movement, rush vs. zone entry, and goalie
positioning.
:::
